deferredSlices.reason: Definitive 2026-06-15 scan: the man_DaedricShrines family is STAT-based (mesh/statue replacers), not ACTI. Zero of the 16 Princes have a clean route anchor; the only ACTIs (Nocturnal x2) carry TempleBlessingScript, which PDV must not replace. Jyggalag/Sithis/Kynareth/Mara are STAT-only; Mehrunes Dagon is worldspace-placement only. A shrine-prayer adapter would require PDV to place its own invisible marker ACTIs/trigger volumes at shrine cell positions (new ESP + placement + runtime) OR a location-trigger hook (new PDV_FLST_HolySites + manager handler) - both ESP/runtime design decisions, held for review. No clean data-only adapter exists. Confirmed by a placed-reference trace: only the two Nocturnal activators are clickable (both TempleBlessingScript->AltarNocturnalSpell 10E8AE, already covered by the shrine-blessing manifest); the other 15 Princes place only decorative STAT meshes with no ACTI/script/spell. SUPERSEDED 2026-06-15: a Base Object Swapper STAT->ACTI base-swap (PDV_Phase21_ARR_ShrinePrayer) makes the statues clickable WITHOUT a native ACTI - 11 Prince prayer Activators built in dist/PDV_AuthoriaARR_Compatibility. The 'no clean adapter' conclusion applied only to overriding the man_ records in place; the swap sidesteps it. Remaining: Kynareth/Mara Aedric prayer variant + the location-trigger half for new-land temples.
Local readback is not runtime/manual proof or Authoria maintainer acceptance.
Optimization review found no broken ARR shrine contract, but pre-existing ManagerQuest/PlayerEvents/DaedricPathBase suboptimal patterns should be fixed or waived before ready/public support.
